visualReview.notes: Inspected 11 current portable views, including the retained 1024×640 summary, and one supplemental ground-level porch view. The retained stepped cream envelope supports a tall central dome, two side domes and a partly occluded rear dome. Five small domes sit above the open pointed porch with gray stone columns, green collars, timber backing fields and an original coarse blue-gray portal surround with three canopy tiers. Three shallow treads meet the gallery. A slender minaret has an open balcony and gray conical cap. The gallery floor can read as a band in oblique views; full-depth low probes reach its backing doors without an intervening wall. The porch ceiling is a flat underside abstraction, not a reconstruction of decorated vaults. Historic artwork, inscriptions, furnished interiors, adjacent fountain/tombs and engineering are omitted.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected 11 current shared-material/geographic views including the placement overlay. Six existing 256² graphs supply lime plaster, coursed limestone, weathered paving, standing-seam metal, bronze and plain wood; seven merged roles include local opaque glazing and colored column/portal accents. Metric UVs and linear tints; no embedded images or unique atlas. Each shared graph is read once and eviction disposes the model geometry. Precise building subtraction follows the union of the named compound and 17 associated parts, including small roof-edge slivers. All 200 independent nearby building records remain, including separate tombs; the fountain POI is excluded. Two ground masks cover the retained envelope and estimated tread apron. The flat overlay establishes approximate pose/replacement, not surveyed terrain contact.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected 27 current medium-fi views: Economy/High, noon/late light, street/block/skyline, silhouette, six details, four matched LODs and four transitions. All levels retain the domed stepped mass, five-bay porch and slender minaret. Skyline has coarse dome facets and simple porch openings; district adds columns, portal bands and window fields; street/closeup refine ribs, grids, canopy and curves. Whole-model cameras retain the complete minaret; detail views intentionally crop other sections. Synthetic apartments and terrain are illustrative. Physical laptop/phone/tablet and full-city performance remain unmeasured.
